notes: «أصاب عثمان بن عفان رعاف» is the story Marwan tells: Uthman is its subject, not a link. «رجل من قريش» and «الحارث» are in the scene. «أبيه» is the father of هشام, not named here: relation.

fixes.reason: RWY adds عثمان بن عفان after مروان بن الحكم as a transmitter, but the text has Marwan telling a story in which Uthman falls ill and names a successor.

evidence.quote: قال أصاب عثمان بن عفان رعاف شديد
